name: connect-1k-exports-prepare-all
description: What: Reset Main to the baseline, load PDataSourceImport at the Size passed, then prepare every export at the Threads passed. connect-setup runs it once to prove every export prepares. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: workloads it runs: connect-database-reset, connect-source-data-load, connect-sql-server-export-prepare, connect-databricks-export-prepare, connect-snowflake-export-prepare, connect-synapse-export-prepare. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.
globalParametersNotes: SourceTableName is the table every size's source backup holds; every shared child reads it from here.

inline.description: What: Restore the PDATA baseline and check the source data load strategy reads PDATA. Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-database-reset' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-database-reset'; its first failed step says what to check.

What: Restore the source backup of the Size passed as ModelSource, check PDATA holds its record count, load PDataSourceImport from it.
